recipes.title: Rain on the Study Window
steps: **Start and sounds — SAVE > PROJECT:** set **KNOB 1 New song**, tap **OCT+**, then tap **OCT+** again if asked. **T1 line — ALGORITHM T1 > SEQ > GEN:** **KNOB 1 MODE TURING**, KNOB 2 LENGTH 8, KNOB 3 PROB 3%, KNOB 4 SPAN 1 octave. **SEQ > PATTERN:** **KNOB 1 LEN 16**, **KNOB 2 DIV 1/4**, **KNOB 3 SWING 12%**, **KNOB 4 GATE 52**. **ARP > EVOLVE:** **KNOB 2 EVERY OFF**, **KNOB 4 ROLL 12**.

Tap **PLAY** once; Tessera performs and stops by itself.
